Introduction to HeroUI v3 – React UI Library

name: HeroUI
summary: Open-source React and React Native component library built on React Aria Components and Tailwind CSS v4.
description: Accessible UI components for React web and React Native, built on Tailwind CSS v4 and React Aria Components with typed APIs, theming and smooth animations. The docs cover installation, component APIs, colors, dark mode, animation, composition, CLI, MCP server and migration from v2. Packages are free and open source; a paid Pro tier adds components, templates and AI tooling.
